'''Cian do Mehon a'Macansa''' is a noble from [[Murandy]]. 

==Appearance==
She is stocky with graying hair.

==Activities==
She is one of the nobles present at the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] meeting on the border of Murandy and [[Andor]]. She snorts loudly when introduced to the Rebel Hall without her titles. 

Egwene believes that she thinks she could make a tidy sum from supplying the rebel camp and army with food and supplies at a fair price. 

She is one of the nobles who inquires with Egwene about the opening up of the novice book to women of all ages.
